title: Spot is affordable, flexible, and no hidden strings
text:
Spot pet insurance is much more affordable than some of the other options out there, while offering a high quality product that has flexible options to meet the exact plan you want.

Pros:
- You can essentially create your own plan by choosing your own deductible and reimbursement percentage to get to a monthly premium that you're comfortable with. 
- The preventative care add on is something I found helpful since we take our dog in for regular check ups.
- I have submitted a few claims already and never had any issues with reimbursement/coverage. You can configure direct deposit, and I've always gotten reimbursement within a week or so of submitting.
- The app is easy to use and makes submitting claims very easy as long as you have proper documentation.

Cons:
- The only con is that they do work on a reimbursement method, meaning that you have to pay out of pocket and submit a claim afterwards to receive reimbursement. This can sometimes be tricky because when the vet is asking if you want to move forward with a treatment, you have to make a decision without having 100% confidence that it will be covered. Spot does have transparent documents that show what is and is not covered, but it can still be stressful to make the decision without 100% confidence. In my experience though, everything that I have expected to be covered was covered.

title: Loyal Customer no more
text:
I have been a loyal customer of Spot since 2021, but after my most recent renewal in November, they have shown their true, heartless colors. My dog, Lady, deserved better than the "convenience" email I received from this company.

They are masters of the bait-and-switch. They moved the goalposts from a general Accidental Death claim to insisting she must have been hit by a car to qualify. When that didn't work, they pivoted to the classic "pre-existing condition" excuse to avoid paying out.

To take my money for years and then deny my claim right after a renewal is disgusting. But the ultimate insult was receiving their cold denial signed off with "Happy Pet Parenting." There is nothing "happy" about how they treat grieving owners and the pets they are supposed to protect.

They don’t care about Lady, and they don’t care about the people who pay their premiums. After four years, I’ve learned that their "coverage" is just a facade. Save your money and your heart—go elsewhere.

title: Spot has been helpful in some ways
text: Spot has been helpful in some ways. They do not seem to actually review high cost concerns, and you have to appeal for reimbursement. Such as last year my dog needed a root canal, which Spot will cover the tooth being pulled but not a root canal, however it being a broken K9 it was not recommended to be pulled by either vet. Spot did not want to cover any of the procedure because it was labeled as a root canal, even though they would’ve covered almost the exact procedure if the tooth was pulled, ie sedation, images, medications, etc. Spot also does not provide any information why something is or is not covered/reimbursed at the end of a claim. You have to go through their customer service to get answers on any claim.  Now that there are several other pet insurance companies, I will be looking into others to see if there is better or easier coverage.

title: Impossible to cancel.…
text:
I had Spot insurance for over a year and luckily never needed to file a claim as my pup stayed healthy. I moved out of the country a few months ago and emailed them to cancel my policy. Note - I emailed the address that they sent my policy info from - which is labeled “reply” and does not send an automatic message or have any notes in their prior message that it’s an unmonitored account. I was charged the following month. I emailed them again - this time attaching random emails from their website that they suggest emailing for quotes. They finally responded and cancelled my plan but argued they wouldn’t honor my original cancellation date. It’s also important to note that they don’t have any emails or instruction on how to cancel on their site. I now have to take this up with my credit card company. I would not suggest Spot to anyone I know. 

Edit - I’m even more disappointed by their blatant lies in their response. There is no footer in the email that the account is unmonitored, the email is reply(several numbers)@mypetinsurer.com. Also there is no automatic message as I mentioned above. And there is no clear information on how to cancel on their website. You can see for yourself.

title: Turnaround Time Isn't Great
text: I was hesitating giving 4 stars, but as I'm a newer customer, I wanted to be fair. I submitted a claim over a week ago, and I just checked the status of my claim and it still says submitted. It hasn't even been queued for review yet. I've had insurance with two different companies with previous pets, and the longest I ever waited for a claim to be processed was 5 days, but they were usually completed in 1-3 days, and that was a few years ago when you'd expect things to move slower. If they need additional information then that will add on even more time. I'm glad I am only satisfying my deductible and not wait for reimbursement. I chose Spot because I'd been told and had read they have fast processing times. When I submitted 8 days ago and it's not even in the queue yet, I wouldn't call that fast. It still has not be queued, assigned, or reviewed. I only wonder how many more days it will be. The first claim I submitted was wellness, and that took 9 days, but I figured that it was my first claim and the rest would probably be faster.
